introBody: Management assures this is temporary. The retired crossing guard left one note taped to the box: count to three before you wave anyone through. Back to Work starts now.
openingLine: Lights on. Cars waiting. You've got this.
mutationLine: Traffic patterns just changed. Nobody mentioned that part.
truckLine: A delivery truck jackknifes. Physics were not in the manual.
ambulanceLine: An ambulance needs through. Everyone else can wait.
closureLine: Road closed ahead. Reroute everyone, calmly, definitely calmly.
resetLine: Intersection reset. Try not to repeat that.
crashLines: You waved four directions at once. Bold strategy.
Cross traffic met itself. Nobody died, mostly.
That was not the walk signal. Whoops.
You optimized for speed. Speed won, everyone lost.
successBody: Every car moved. Every pedestrian survived. Management calls it a model deployment. You call it Tuesday.
messyBody: Three fender benders, one confused pigeon, and a rerouted parade. Nobody got hurt. Management is calling this a learning curve.
futureHook: The intersection was just the beginning. The city has other jobs.
